subject: Action slate & Week0 playbook — MAP templates and draft doc
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@cypherhealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP templates & proposed pilot cadence

Hi Marissa —

Quick note from our side: we’re preparing an internal evaluation plan for a small pilot focused on triage/notes summarization. Our procurement and engineering leads asked for a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a Week0 playbook so they can see milestone dates and what success looks like.

Can you share whatever template you typically use and a first-pass draft we can review? Ideally something that spells out:
- Week0 kickoff objectives and tech readiness checklist
- 2-week pilot milestones and acceptance gates
- Stakeholder roles and sign-offs (legal/infosec/eng)

We’re aiming to start the pilot the week of Oct 11.

Thanks —
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Director of AI Programs
Cypher Health
elena@cypherhealth.com
(415) 555-2087

Hi Elena —

Great to hear — thanks for the clarity on scope and the Oct 11 target. I’m attaching our lightweight MAP action slate and a Week0 slide seed to get us moving. I also created a collaborative Google Doc so we can iterate on acceptance criteria together: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDk-map-template-draft

Attachments (stubs):
- MAP_Action_Slate_Template_v1.pdf (40KB) — fields for milestones, owners, SLOs.
- week0_playbook_slide_deck.pptx (2 slides) — kickoff agenda + readiness checklist.

Quick ask: can you confirm who from Cypher will be the primary technical owner and the legal/infosec reviewer? Ben is looped for the infra and latency acceptance metrics; Jasmine is on the thread for onboarding/CS commitments.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Quick sync (30m) to align stakeholders and lock Week0 objectives — are you available Oct 4 or Oct 6?
2) We’ll iterate the MAP doc in the shared GDoc and circulate a final version for sign-off by Oct 8.

Marissa

Thanks Marissa. From our side I’ll draft the infra acceptance checklist items for the MAP (latency @ p95, throughput targets, KV cache sizing, data ingress method). Two quick questions for Elena:

- Any constraints on retention/PD data handling we should include in the acceptance matrix?

I’ll put a lightweight technical appendix into the GDoc by end of day.
